name: @tencent/tencent-docs-ai-engine
description: Tencent Docs AI Engine. Spawn-and-supervise wrapper around the bundled `editor_sdk` binary (serves the JSON-RPC MCP endpoint /mcp consumed by agent CLIs and the editor preview assets /static/<type>/pc.html on a single port, default :39099; lazy start, stdout-based readiness detection, graceful shutdown) plus the local-docs scenario layer (prompt fragment + variable collector + cwd-based detector) used by host system-prompt renderers.
